card.name: Spell Scribing
card.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

card.name: Arcane Insight
card.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

card.name: Matrix Efficiency
card.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

card.name: Scholarly Mind
card.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

card.name: Arcane Bolt
card.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

card.name: Minor Conjuration
card.frequency: At will while RP remains; one object at a time
card.effect: Minor Conjuration. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, conjuration. Create one nonmagical unattended object that fits inside a 1-foot cube, weighs no more than 10 pounds and is made of common nonvaluable material such as wood, cloth, clay, iron or glass. It cannot be food, poison, currency, a spell component with listed cost, ammunition with special properties or a functional complex mechanism. Creating another dismisses the first.

source.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

card.name: Arcane Shield
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

card.name: Analyze Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
card.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

card.name: Spellbook Study
card.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

card.name: Floating Preparation
card.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

card.name: Sigil Rewrite
card.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

card.name: Spell Tether
card.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

card.name: Matrix Mastery
card.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Tradition
card.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
card.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

card.name: Improved Concentration
card.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Arcane Lock
card.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
card.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

card.name: Dispel Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
card.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

card.name: Dimensional Pocket
card.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Spell Preservation
card.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Arcane Memory
card.cost: Normal RP cost of recalled spell
card.effect: Arcane Memory. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, spellbook. Cast one legal-rank Wizard spell that you previously prepared and have recorded in your campaign memory log, even if it is not currently prepared or its spellbook entry is unavailable. Pay the normal RP cost and obey casting time, concentration and all ordinary restrictions. This grants no spell above your Wizard rank limit.

source.originalText: Arcane Memory: Recall and cast any spell you've ever prepared once per long rest.

card.name: Seal Magic
card.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

card.name: Ritual Casting
card.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
card.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
card.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

card.name: School Mastery
card.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Overchannel
card.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

card.name: Tethered Cast
card.rangeAndTarget: One concentration Wizard spell you cast this turn that targets only yourself or one willing ally
card.frequency: At most once per round; only one Tethered Cast active at a time
card.effect: Source progression line 5192. After casting the qualifying spell, tether it. The tethered spell no longer occupies your one normal concentration slot for up to 3 rounds. When damage would require a concentration save for the tethered spell, make the save normally; failure ends only the tether. Starting another Tethered Cast ends the existing tether first. A Tethered Cast cannot itself tether Spell Tether's second spell or permit more than two simultaneously sustained Wizard effects.

source.originalText: | 17 | Tethered Cast (bonus action spell link 1/round) |

Before casting, choose one: change its acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage to another type in that list; or change a 10-foot-radius area to a 15-foot cone, a 15-foot cone to a 30-foot line, or a 30-foot line to a 10-foot radius. Dice, save, duration and other effects remain unchanged.

source.originalText: Spell Adaptation: Change a spell's damage type or effect type once per short rest.

card.name: Elemental Affinity
card.duration: Permanent until changed by Core Sync
card.frequency: Automatic when Elementalist is chosen; counts as one level-10 Hero acquisition
card.effect: Elemental Affinity. Tags: hero, elementalist, elemental, automatic. Choose Fire, Cold, Lightning or Earth when entering Elementalist. Fire corresponds to fire damage, Cold to cold, Lightning to lightning and Earth to magical bludgeoning damage created by earth effects. Wizard spells matching the affinity gain +2 to their Wizard save DC or +2 on their spell attack, as applicable, and once per spell add one extra die matching that spell's primary damage die to one damage roll.

source.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Choose 1 element (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth); all spells of that element gain +2 DC, +1 damage tier

card.name: Combo Surge
card.rangeAndTarget: One target damaged by the second qualifying spell
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn plus listed damage
card.effect: Combo Surge. Tags: hero, elementalist, elemental, combo. When you damage the same creature on consecutive regular turns with the required pair in either order, you may trigger one combo. Fire + Cold: the target takes 1d6 fire at the start of its next turn and makes a Strength save; failure Restrains it until the end of that turn. Lightning + Earth: the target is knocked Prone and makes a Constitution save; failure Stuns it until the end of its next turn, subject to one successful Combo-Surge Stun per target per encounter. Other element pairs have no Combo Surge in this pilot.

source.originalText: Combo Surge: Casting two different elements in sequence triggers a combo effect

card.name: Spell Modification
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Spell Modification. Tags: hero, elementalist, matrix. Choose exactly one modification before casting: Range increases by 30 feet; Area increases a circular radius or cone length by 5 feet or a line length by 10 feet; Duration doubles a non-concentration duration with a printed maximum of 5 rounds or less, to no more than 10 rounds. It cannot alter target count, concentration status, Actions, saving-throw cadence or damage dice.

source.originalText: Spell Modification: Alter a prepared spell on the fly, changing its range, duration, or area of effect.

card.name: Arcane Fusion
card.cost: Combined normal RP costs of both spells + 2 RP
card.duration: Instantaneous or as individual legal effects
card.effect: Arcane Fusion. Tags: hero, elementalist, fusion, matrix. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 5 or lower, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Pay both full RP costs plus 2 and resolve both spells sequentially as one Action. They may share or have different legal targets. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates protected first-cast/Refrain state, but features triggered by 'casting a spell' may trigger only once from the Fusion, chosen by you. Fusion itself cannot be copied, Shared or used inside Dual Cast.

source.originalText: Arcane Fusion: Combine two spells into a single, more powerful effect.

card.name: Ritual Casting
card.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
card.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
card.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

card.name: School Mastery
card.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

card.name: Arcane Ward
card.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

card.name: Overchannel
card.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
card.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

card.name: Arcane Feedback
card.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

card.name: Tethered Cast
card.rangeAndTarget: One concentration Wizard spell you cast this turn that targets only yourself or one willing ally
card.frequency: At most once per round; only one Tethered Cast active at a time
card.effect: Source progression line 5192. After casting the qualifying spell, tether it. The tethered spell no longer occupies your one normal concentration slot for up to 3 rounds. When damage would require a concentration save for the tethered spell, make the save normally; failure ends only the tether. Starting another Tethered Cast ends the existing tether first. A Tethered Cast cannot itself tether Spell Tether's second spell or permit more than two simultaneously sustained Wizard effects.

source.originalText: | 17 | Tethered Cast (bonus action spell link 1/round) |

card.name: Spellcasting
card.effect: Spellcasting. Tags: core, spellcasting. You automatically gain Mage spellcasting and access to the Mage repertoire permitted by your separately reconciled spell progression, including Evocation Tier I at the level specified by Core Systems. Use Intelligence for Mage spell attacks and save DCs. This feature is never purchased with a class-feature choice.

source.originalText: Spellcasting: Access to Evocation Tier I spells, focusing on direct damage.

card.name: Resonance Pool
card.effect: Resonance Pool. Tags: core, resonance. Your Mage spells and Mage class-spell cards draw from the same Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. Use the authoritative Mage RP maximum by Mage level. This card creates no second pool, no spell slots and no additional recovery method. It is never purchased with a class-feature choice.

source.originalText: Resonance Pool: A reservoir of arcane energy that powers your spells and recovers during rest.

card.name: Arcane Insight
card.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. After examining a magical item, spell residue, ward or active magical effect for 1 minute, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to identify its school, broad function or elemental signature. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no fabricated information.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-mages.

card.name: Elemental Affinity
card.frequency: Always after Elemental Focus is chosen
card.effect: Elemental Affinity. Tags: passive, elemental. Gain resistance to the damage type of your current Elemental Focus: fire for Fire, cold for Cold or lightning for Lightning. If Elemental Pivot temporarily changes your Focus, this resistance changes with it and returns to your original element when the Pivot ends.

source.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Gain a minor resistance to your chosen element once selected.

card.name: Spell Precision
card.effect: Spell Precision. Tags: passive, spell. When you cast a Mage spell that forces creatures in an area to make a saving throw, choose up to M creatures you can perceive in that area. Those creatures automatically succeed on that spell's initial save and take no damage if a normal successful save would deal half damage. This does not protect them from later independent hazards or pulses.

source.originalText: Spell Precision: Reduce the chance of friendly fire damage from your area effect spells.

card.name: Arcane Missile
card.effect: Arcane Missile. Tags: mage-spell, arcane, damage. The missile automatically hits one creature you can perceive within range and deals S d4 + M force damage. No attack roll or saving throw is made. It is non-elemental, so casting it clears an Elemental Focus Nuke Chain. Multiple missiles are represented by the scaling dice, not separate hits or triggers.

source.originalText: Arcane Missile: Launch bolts of pure arcane energy that unerringly strike your target.

card.name: Elemental Bolt
card.effect: Elemental Bolt. Tags: mage-spell, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal S d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire: target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn. Cold: Speed -10 feet until the end of its next turn. Lightning: one different enemy within 10 feet takes S lightning damage. Secondary damage creates no new spell cast or chain credit.

source.originalText: Elemental Bolt: Cast a bolt of your chosen element (once selected) that deals additional effects based on the element.

card.name: Resonance Shield
card.cost: Spend X RP, where X is 1, 2 or 3
card.duration: 1 minute or until temporary HP are lost
card.effect: Resonance Shield. Tags: mage-spell, abjuration, protection. Spend 1-3 RP and gain temporary HP equal to X × (S + M). Temporary HP do not stack. This spell is non-elemental and therefore clears an active Elemental Nuke Chain. Its RP payment cannot be reduced below 1 by Spell Efficiency.

source.originalText: Resonance Shield: Convert a portion of your Resonance Points into a temporary protective barrier.

card.name: Blink
card.effect: Blink. Tags: mage-spell, teleportation. Teleport to an unoccupied space you can perceive within 30 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks and cannot pass through planar wards that prohibit teleportation. Blink deals no damage and is non-elemental, so using it clears an active Elemental Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Blink: Teleport a short distance to avoid danger or reposition.

card.name: Detect Magic
card.effect: Detect Magic. Tags: mage-spell, divination, concentration. While concentrating, sense the presence and approximate location of active magical auras within 30 feet that are not completely blocked by an effect specifically preventing magical detection. Spending an Action examining one sensed aura reveals its broad school or elemental character. It is non-elemental and clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Detect Magic: Sense and identify magical auras and effects in your vicinity.

card.name: Cold
card.cost: 0; Glacier Spike costs 2 RP when primed
card.duration: Permanent Focus; finisher instantaneous plus slow
card.frequency: Choose at Mage 2; finisher recharge 3 rounds
card.effect: Elemental Focus — Cold. Tags: focus, cold. Once on each of your turns, a natural 19 that hits with a Cold Mage spell is a critical hit. When a Cold Mage spell damages a creature, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, minimum 0. FINISHER — Glacier Spike: after a completed Cold Nuke Chain, Bonus Action, 2 RP. Creatures in a 15-foot cone make Constitution saves, taking (S+1)d8 cold on failure or half on success; failed creatures have their Speed halved until the end of their next turn.

source.originalText: Cold: +5% crit chance, slows targets. Finisher: Glacier Spike – Cone AoE, 50% slow

card.name: Arcane Stability
card.effect: Arcane Stability. Tags: arcanist, passive. When damage causes you to make a concentration save for a Mage spell, add +2 to that save. This bonus does not stack with another feature named Arcane Stability and does not change the concentration DC. It does not prevent Silence, incapacitation or effects that end concentration without a save.

source.originalText: Arcane Stability: Reduce spell fizzle chance by 25%.

card.name: Overload Crits
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 10 feet of a creature critically hit by your damaging Mage spell
card.effect: Overload Crits. Tags: arcanist, critical. When a damaging Mage spell scores a critical hit, choose one different enemy within 10 feet of the critically hit target. It takes damage of the same type equal to 50% of the spell's base unmodified damage dice total before critical extra dice, rounded down once, minimum 1. Flat bonuses, riders and critical extra dice are not copied again.

source.originalText: Overload Crits: Critical strikes deal +50% splash damage to nearby enemies.

card.name: Arcane Bypass
card.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Arcane Bypass. Tags: arcanist, penetration. Before paying costs for a damaging Mage spell, declare Arcane Bypass. Damage from that spell ignores resistance to its printed damage types. Immunity remains immunity. The declaration is spent once the spell is legally cast even if all attacks miss or all targets succeed on saves.

source.originalText: Arcane Bypass: Once per rest, ignore all enemy resistances for one spell.

card.name: Metaspell Access
card.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
card.frequency: 1/long rest; choose one metamagic mode when this feature is acquired
card.effect: Metaspell Access. Tags: arcanist, metamagic. Choose one mode permanently: Reach increases one spell's range by 30 feet; Widen increases one circular radius or cone length by 5 feet; Sculpt lets up to M creatures automatically succeed on that spell's initial area save and take no damage if success normally halves damage. Apply the chosen mode once per long rest before casting; it does not alter RP cost or create another cast.

source.originalText: Metaspell Access: Choose one Universal Metamagic effect to apply to a spell once per day.

card.name: Elemental Mastery
card.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: arcanist, focus. Improve the secondary effect of your current Focus. Fire Burns from your Focus cards last one additional turn but never stack. Cold Focus Speed reductions increase by another 5 feet, minimum 0. Lightning Focus's once-per-turn secondary arc increases from S flat lightning damage to S d4 lightning damage. Pivoted Focus uses the corresponding upgraded rider.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Increase the effectiveness of your chosen element's secondary effects.

card.name: Elemental Surge
card.effect: Elemental Surge. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal (S+1)d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire also applies the Focus Burn; Cold applies the Focus Speed reduction; Lightning applies the Focus secondary arc. This is Focus-eligible and can occupy one slot in a Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Channel a concentrated burst of your chosen element, dealing high damage to a single target.

card.name: Arcane Barrage
card.effect: Arcane Barrage. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, arcane, damage. Create S+2 force bolts. Each bolt automatically hits one creature you can perceive within 60 feet for 1d4 force damage. Distribute bolts among any number of legal targets, but all bolts together are one spell cast. This spell is non-elemental and clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Arcane Barrage: Launch multiple arcane projectiles that seek out different targets.

card.name: Conjure Elemental Familiar
card.effect: Conjure Elemental Familiar. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, summon, elemental. Summon one elemental familiar matching your current Focus using the common familiar stat block. Only one elemental familiar from this feature may exist at once; summoning another dismisses the first. It obeys the shared Companion Command rule. It disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and leaves no corpse, XP, loot or resource trigger.

source.originalText: Conjure Elemental Familiar: Summon a minor elemental of your chosen type to assist you in combat.

card.name: Displacement
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Displacement. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, illusion, teleportation. Teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you perceive and create two illusory duplicates. Until the start of your next regular turn, the next two attack rolls made against you have disadvantage; each attack roll consumes one duplicate whether it hits or misses. Area effects ignore the duplicates. This non-elemental spell clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Displacement: Create illusory duplicates of yourself while teleporting to safety.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding your proficiency bonus against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. On success the triggering spell is negated after its costs are paid. On failure it proceeds normally. Counterspell is non-elemental and, because it is itself a spell, clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Elemental Pivot
card.duration: Until encounter ends or you dismiss it
card.effect: Elemental Pivot. Tags: elementalist, focus. Switch your current Elemental Focus to one of the other two Focuses. Your Elemental Affinity, Focus passive, Elemental Mastery rider and available finisher change to that element. Clear the current Nuke Chain and any primed finisher when Pivot occurs. At encounter end your original level-2 Focus automatically returns.

source.originalText: Elemental Pivot: Switch focus element mid-combat as a bonus action.

card.name: Elemental Fusion
card.effect: Elemental Fusion. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, elemental, damage. Choose your current Focus and one other element among Fire, Cold and Lightning. Make a Mage spell attack. On hit deal S d8 of each chosen element. Pair rider: Fire+Cold reduces Speed by 10 feet and applies 1d4 fire at start of target's next turn; Fire+Lightning removes Reaction until start of target's next turn; Cold+Lightning reduces Speed by 10 feet and prevents opportunity attacks until end of target's next turn. For Nuke Chain purposes this spell counts only as your current Focus element.

source.originalText: Elemental Fusion: Combine two elements to create a hybrid spell with unique effects.

card.name: Cascade Storm
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three different creatures within 60 feet
card.effect: Cascade Storm. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, fire, cold, lightning, damage. Choose up to three creatures. Resolve one separate Mage spell attack against each: first hit deals S d6 fire and 1d4 fire next turn; second hit deals S d6 cold and Speed -10 feet until end next turn; third hit deals S d6 lightning and removes Reaction until start next turn. If fewer than three targets are chosen, unused elements are lost. For Nuke Chain purposes choose one of the three elements before casting; Cascade Storm counts only as that element.

source.originalText: Cascade Storm: Trigger a sequence of elemental effects that build upon each other.

card.name: Elemental Absorption
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Elemental Absorption. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, protection. Trigger when you would take fire, cold or lightning damage. Gain resistance to that triggering damage type for the triggering event and until the end of your next regular turn. Your next damaging Mage spell before then adds 1d8 of the absorbed type to one damage roll; the bonus is lost after use or expiry. This Reaction spell clears an incompatible current Nuke Chain unless the absorbed type is your current Focus.

source.originalText: Elemental Absorption: Temporarily absorb incoming elemental damage to enhance your next spell.

card.name: Primal Channeling
card.effect: Primal Channeling. Tags: elementalist, resonance. During a real encounter, draw ambient elemental energy and restore 2 RP, never above your maximum. You cannot use Primal Channeling outside a real encounter, during a rest, through a summoned proxy or more than once per short rest. It does not count as a spell cast, does not advance Nuke Chain and does not alter Dissonance.

source.originalText: Primal Channeling: Draw raw elemental energy from the environment to empower your spells.

source.originalText:
Druidic
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

card.name: Spellcasting
card.effect: Prepare and cast according to the engine. WIS attack/DC; rank gates, components, concentration, Dissonance and RP apply. This entry creates no extra actions or second resource pool.

source.originalText:
Spellcasting
Drawing on the essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the druid spell list.
Cantrips
At 1st level, you know two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. You learn additional druid cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Druid table.
Preparing and Casting Spells
The Druid table shows how many Resonance Points you have to cast your druid spells. A spell's base RP cost is twice its Resonance Rank (Rank 0 cantrips cost 0), modified by explicit class features and current Dissonance. You regain expended RP according to the Resonance recovery rules.
You prepare the list of druid spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the druid spell list. When you do so, choose a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have Resonance Points.
For example, if you are a 3rd-level druid, you have 7 Resonance Points. With a Wisdom of 16, your list of prepared spells can include six spells, and they can be of 1st or 2nd level in any combination. If you prepare the Rank 1 spell cure wounds, its base cost is 2 Resonance Points before explicit specialization or Dissonance modifiers. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.
You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of druid spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.
Spellcasting Ability
Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a druid spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Ritual Casting
You can cast a druid spell as a ritual if that spell has the ritual tag and you have the spell prepared.

Spellcasting Focus
You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

card.cost: One shift; buffer drawn from reserve

+20 HP temporary buffer

Claw: 2d6 slashing damage
Rage-like trait: Deal +1 damage per attack

card.effect: Tiny, flight 60 ft, walking 10 ft, advantage on sight Perception. Talon 1d4 slashing+WIS; advantage if you descended at least 10 ft immediately before attack. No carrying Medium allies or casting spells before 18.

source.originalText:
Hawk Form (Scout)
Flight speed of 60 ft.
Keen Sight: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight
Dive Attack: 1d4 slashing damage + advantage if striking from above

card.effect: Resistance to slashing. Tusk 1d6 piercing+WIS. After moving 10 ft directly toward target, first hit/turn adds 1d6 and STR save or push 5 ft; no repeated charges from forced movement.

source.originalText:

Timeless Body
Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

card.name: Beast Spells
card.effect: Perform verbal/somatic Druid spell components in any form. Still cannot supply material components from melded gear. At 20 Archdruid waives only noncostly unconsumed components.

source.originalText:
Beast Spells
Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Shapeshifting. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

card.name: Dire Wolf
card.duration: Form 10 minutes; fear up to 3 rounds
card.effect: Arch attunement required. Speed 40 ft, bite 2d6 piercing+WIS; advantage when active ally threatens target 5 ft. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened, repeat end each turn, maximum 3 rounds. No free bite with Howl.

Ironhorn Ram

Shadow Lynx

card.effect: Restore 1d8 real HP per RP paid, never beyond maximum. Does not restore temporary buffer or shift uses. No Dissonance as class technique; cannot heal after form ended/incapacitated.

source.originalText:
Combat Shapeshifting
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain Combat Shapeshifting. While transformed by Shapeshifting, you can use a bonus action to expend one or more Resonance Points, regaining 1d8 hit points for each RP expended. Activating Shapeshifting itself still spends a Shapeshifting use, not RP.

card.name: Circle Forms
card.effect: Add S damage to first natural-form hit each turn. Bounded replacement for importing higher-CR monsters; all form gates and attunement remain.

source.originalText:
Circle Forms
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Shapeshifting to transform into more powerful beast forms than a typical druid. Your level as a druid determines the maximum CR of the form you can take, as shown in the Druid table.

card.name: Primal Strike
card.effect: Form attacks count as magical against defenses to nonmagical physical attacks. Does not ignore immunity to their actual damage type.

source.originalText:
Primal Strike
Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

card.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing; first hit/turn adds 1d4 of one chosen fire/cold/lightning, not all three. Up to 2 beast allies 30 ft gain+1 first attack/turn. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened until end next turn.

Howl Action choose up to 3 allies gain 2d8 temp HP total roll, or 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened through end next turn. Temp HP draws from Buffer Reserve per recipient.

Mooncursed
Lycanthropic Resilience: You have resistance to all damage except silver

card.name: Elemental Shapeshifting
card.cost: One shift and one elemental use
card.effect: Choose bounded elemental form: AC 16, natural attack 2d8+WIS chosen element, one/Action. Air flight 60 lightning resistance; Earth burrow 20 through loose soil physical DR 2; Fire fire resistance and melee attacker 1d4 fire once/round; Water swim 60 water breathing cold resistance. Retain own HP/abilities, no external stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Elemental Shapeshifting
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into an elemental. You can transform into an air elemental, an earth elemental, a fire elemental, or a water elemental. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

card.name: Spellcasting
card.effect: Spellcasting. Tags: core, spellcasting. You automatically gain Mage spellcasting and access to the Mage repertoire permitted by your separately reconciled spell progression, including Evocation Tier I at the level specified by Core Systems. Use Intelligence for Mage spell attacks and save DCs. This feature is never purchased with a class-feature choice.

source.originalText: Spellcasting: Access to Evocation Tier I spells, focusing on direct damage.

card.name: Resonance Pool
card.effect: Resonance Pool. Tags: core, resonance. Your Mage spells and Mage class-spell cards draw from the same Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. Use the authoritative Mage RP maximum by Mage level. This card creates no second pool, no spell slots and no additional recovery method. It is never purchased with a class-feature choice.

source.originalText: Resonance Pool: A reservoir of arcane energy that powers your spells and recovers during rest.

card.name: Arcane Insight
card.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. After examining a magical item, spell residue, ward or active magical effect for 1 minute, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to identify its school, broad function or elemental signature. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no fabricated information.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-mages.

card.name: Elemental Affinity
card.frequency: Always after Elemental Focus is chosen
card.effect: Elemental Affinity. Tags: passive, elemental. Gain resistance to the damage type of your current Elemental Focus: fire for Fire, cold for Cold or lightning for Lightning. If Elemental Pivot temporarily changes your Focus, this resistance changes with it and returns to your original element when the Pivot ends.

source.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Gain a minor resistance to your chosen element once selected.

card.name: Spell Precision
card.effect: Spell Precision. Tags: passive, spell. When you cast a Mage spell that forces creatures in an area to make a saving throw, choose up to M creatures you can perceive in that area. Those creatures automatically succeed on that spell's initial save and take no damage if a normal successful save would deal half damage. This does not protect them from later independent hazards or pulses.

source.originalText: Spell Precision: Reduce the chance of friendly fire damage from your area effect spells.

card.name: Arcane Missile
card.effect: Arcane Missile. Tags: mage-spell, arcane, damage. The missile automatically hits one creature you can perceive within range and deals S d4 + M force damage. No attack roll or saving throw is made. It is non-elemental, so casting it clears an Elemental Focus Nuke Chain. Multiple missiles are represented by the scaling dice, not separate hits or triggers.

source.originalText: Arcane Missile: Launch bolts of pure arcane energy that unerringly strike your target.

card.name: Elemental Bolt
card.effect: Elemental Bolt. Tags: mage-spell, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal S d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire: target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn. Cold: Speed -10 feet until the end of its next turn. Lightning: one different enemy within 10 feet takes S lightning damage. Secondary damage creates no new spell cast or chain credit.

source.originalText: Elemental Bolt: Cast a bolt of your chosen element (once selected) that deals additional effects based on the element.

card.name: Resonance Shield
card.cost: Spend X RP, where X is 1, 2 or 3
card.duration: 1 minute or until temporary HP are lost
card.effect: Resonance Shield. Tags: mage-spell, abjuration, protection. Spend 1-3 RP and gain temporary HP equal to X × (S + M). Temporary HP do not stack. This spell is non-elemental and therefore clears an active Elemental Nuke Chain. Its RP payment cannot be reduced below 1 by Spell Efficiency.

source.originalText: Resonance Shield: Convert a portion of your Resonance Points into a temporary protective barrier.

card.name: Blink
card.effect: Blink. Tags: mage-spell, teleportation. Teleport to an unoccupied space you can perceive within 30 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks and cannot pass through planar wards that prohibit teleportation. Blink deals no damage and is non-elemental, so using it clears an active Elemental Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Blink: Teleport a short distance to avoid danger or reposition.

card.name: Detect Magic
card.effect: Detect Magic. Tags: mage-spell, divination, concentration. While concentrating, sense the presence and approximate location of active magical auras within 30 feet that are not completely blocked by an effect specifically preventing magical detection. Spending an Action examining one sensed aura reveals its broad school or elemental character. It is non-elemental and clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Detect Magic: Sense and identify magical auras and effects in your vicinity.

card.name: Cold
card.cost: 0; Glacier Spike costs 2 RP when primed
card.duration: Permanent Focus; finisher instantaneous plus slow
card.frequency: Choose at Mage 2; finisher recharge 3 rounds
card.effect: Elemental Focus — Cold. Tags: focus, cold. Once on each of your turns, a natural 19 that hits with a Cold Mage spell is a critical hit. When a Cold Mage spell damages a creature, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, minimum 0. FINISHER — Glacier Spike: after a completed Cold Nuke Chain, Bonus Action, 2 RP. Creatures in a 15-foot cone make Constitution saves, taking (S+1)d8 cold on failure or half on success; failed creatures have their Speed halved until the end of their next turn.

source.originalText: Cold: +5% crit chance, slows targets. Finisher: Glacier Spike – Cone AoE, 50% slow

card.name: Arcane Stability
card.effect: Arcane Stability. Tags: arcanist, passive. When damage causes you to make a concentration save for a Mage spell, add +2 to that save. This bonus does not stack with another feature named Arcane Stability and does not change the concentration DC. It does not prevent Silence, incapacitation or effects that end concentration without a save.

source.originalText: Arcane Stability: Reduce spell fizzle chance by 25%.

card.name: Overload Crits
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 10 feet of a creature critically hit by your damaging Mage spell
card.effect: Overload Crits. Tags: arcanist, critical. When a damaging Mage spell scores a critical hit, choose one different enemy within 10 feet of the critically hit target. It takes damage of the same type equal to 50% of the spell's base unmodified damage dice total before critical extra dice, rounded down once, minimum 1. Flat bonuses, riders and critical extra dice are not copied again.

source.originalText: Overload Crits: Critical strikes deal +50% splash damage to nearby enemies.

card.name: Arcane Bypass
card.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
card.effect: Arcane Bypass. Tags: arcanist, penetration. Before paying costs for a damaging Mage spell, declare Arcane Bypass. Damage from that spell ignores resistance to its printed damage types. Immunity remains immunity. The declaration is spent once the spell is legally cast even if all attacks miss or all targets succeed on saves.

source.originalText: Arcane Bypass: Once per rest, ignore all enemy resistances for one spell.

card.name: Metaspell Access
card.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
card.frequency: 1/long rest; choose one metamagic mode when this feature is acquired
card.effect: Metaspell Access. Tags: arcanist, metamagic. Choose one mode permanently: Reach increases one spell's range by 30 feet; Widen increases one circular radius or cone length by 5 feet; Sculpt lets up to M creatures automatically succeed on that spell's initial area save and take no damage if success normally halves damage. Apply the chosen mode once per long rest before casting; it does not alter RP cost or create another cast.

source.originalText: Metaspell Access: Choose one Universal Metamagic effect to apply to a spell once per day.

card.name: Elemental Mastery
card.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: arcanist, focus. Improve the secondary effect of your current Focus. Fire Burns from your Focus cards last one additional turn but never stack. Cold Focus Speed reductions increase by another 5 feet, minimum 0. Lightning Focus's once-per-turn secondary arc increases from S flat lightning damage to S d4 lightning damage. Pivoted Focus uses the corresponding upgraded rider.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Increase the effectiveness of your chosen element's secondary effects.

card.name: Elemental Surge
card.effect: Elemental Surge. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal (S+1)d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire also applies the Focus Burn; Cold applies the Focus Speed reduction; Lightning applies the Focus secondary arc. This is Focus-eligible and can occupy one slot in a Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Channel a concentrated burst of your chosen element, dealing high damage to a single target.

card.name: Arcane Barrage
card.effect: Arcane Barrage. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, arcane, damage. Create S+2 force bolts. Each bolt automatically hits one creature you can perceive within 60 feet for 1d4 force damage. Distribute bolts among any number of legal targets, but all bolts together are one spell cast. This spell is non-elemental and clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Arcane Barrage: Launch multiple arcane projectiles that seek out different targets.

card.name: Conjure Elemental Familiar
card.effect: Conjure Elemental Familiar. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, summon, elemental. Summon one elemental familiar matching your current Focus using the common familiar stat block. Only one elemental familiar from this feature may exist at once; summoning another dismisses the first. It obeys the shared Companion Command rule. It disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and leaves no corpse, XP, loot or resource trigger.

source.originalText: Conjure Elemental Familiar: Summon a minor elemental of your chosen type to assist you in combat.

card.name: Displacement
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Displacement. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, illusion, teleportation. Teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you perceive and create two illusory duplicates. Until the start of your next regular turn, the next two attack rolls made against you have disadvantage; each attack roll consumes one duplicate whether it hits or misses. Area effects ignore the duplicates. This non-elemental spell clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Displacement: Create illusory duplicates of yourself while teleporting to safety.

card.name: Counterspell
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
card.effect: Counterspell. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding your proficiency bonus against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. On success the triggering spell is negated after its costs are paid. On failure it proceeds normally. Counterspell is non-elemental and, because it is itself a spell, clears an active Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

card.name: Elemental Pivot
card.duration: Until encounter ends or you dismiss it
card.effect: Elemental Pivot. Tags: elementalist, focus. Switch your current Elemental Focus to one of the other two Focuses. Your Elemental Affinity, Focus passive, Elemental Mastery rider and available finisher change to that element. Clear the current Nuke Chain and any primed finisher when Pivot occurs. At encounter end your original level-2 Focus automatically returns.

source.originalText: Elemental Pivot: Switch focus element mid-combat as a bonus action.

card.name: Elemental Overload
card.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot square centered on a point within 30 feet of a target damaged by your elemental spell
card.effect: Elemental Overload. Tags: elementalist, elemental, area. After a Fire, Cold or Lightning Mage spell deals damage, spend 2 RP and choose one different element from those three. Creatures of your choice in the square make Dexterity saves, taking S d6 damage of the triggering type plus S d6 of the chosen second type on failure, half on success. This is one triggered effect, not another spell cast.

source.originalText: Elemental Overload: Deal dual-element damage in a 3x3 blast.

card.name: Elemental Fusion
card.effect: Elemental Fusion. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, elemental, damage. Choose your current Focus and one other element among Fire, Cold and Lightning. Make a Mage spell attack. On hit deal S d8 of each chosen element. Pair rider: Fire+Cold reduces Speed by 10 feet and applies 1d4 fire at start of target's next turn; Fire+Lightning removes Reaction until start of target's next turn; Cold+Lightning reduces Speed by 10 feet and prevents opportunity attacks until end of target's next turn. For Nuke Chain purposes this spell counts only as your current Focus element.

source.originalText: Elemental Fusion: Combine two elements to create a hybrid spell with unique effects.

card.name: Cascade Storm
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three different creatures within 60 feet
card.effect: Cascade Storm. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, fire, cold, lightning, damage. Choose up to three creatures. Resolve one separate Mage spell attack against each: first hit deals S d6 fire and 1d4 fire next turn; second hit deals S d6 cold and Speed -10 feet until end next turn; third hit deals S d6 lightning and removes Reaction until start next turn. If fewer than three targets are chosen, unused elements are lost. For Nuke Chain purposes choose one of the three elements before casting; Cascade Storm counts only as that element.

source.originalText: Cascade Storm: Trigger a sequence of elemental effects that build upon each other.

card.name: Elemental Absorption
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Elemental Absorption. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, protection. Trigger when you would take fire, cold or lightning damage. Gain resistance to that triggering damage type for the triggering event and until the end of your next regular turn. Your next damaging Mage spell before then adds 1d8 of the absorbed type to one damage roll; the bonus is lost after use or expiry. This Reaction spell clears an incompatible current Nuke Chain unless the absorbed type is your current Focus.

source.originalText: Elemental Absorption: Temporarily absorb incoming elemental damage to enhance your next spell.

card.name: Primal Channeling
card.effect: Primal Channeling. Tags: elementalist, resonance. During a real encounter, draw ambient elemental energy and restore 2 RP, never above your maximum. You cannot use Primal Channeling outside a real encounter, during a rest, through a summoned proxy or more than once per short rest. It does not count as a spell cast, does not advance Nuke Chain and does not alter Dissonance.

source.originalText: Primal Channeling: Draw raw elemental energy from the environment to empower your spells.

card.name: Spell Efficiency
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Spell Efficiency. Tags: arcanist, resonance, focus. After you legally cast a Focus-eligible spell, your next differently named Focus-eligible spell of the same current element before the end of your next regular turn costs 1 less RP, minimum 1 RP. This reduction cannot apply to Focus finishers, Resonance Surge's additional cost or a spell already reduced to 0 by another explicit feature.

source.originalText: Spell Efficiency: Reduce the Resonance Point cost of spells cast in sequence with the same element.

card.name: Elemental Mastery
card.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: elementalist, focus, mastery. For 3 rounds, Fire, Cold and Lightning Mage spells all count as matching your current Focus for Nuke Chain eligibility. After you complete one three-distinct-name chain during this duration, you may choose any one of the three Focus finishers when it becomes primed, regardless of your current Focus. Only one finisher may be generated by this use. After that finisher resolves or expires, the mastery continues defensively but cannot prime another off-focus finisher.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Temporarily gain mastery over all elements, allowing you to use any elemental finisher regardless of your focus.
